name: ravenSDR
description: Real-time RF Signal Transcription Pipeline — RTL-SDR → Edge AI Inference (Hailo-8L NPU) → Live Web Interface

stack.aptDecoder: aptdec (built from source; noaa-apt needs Rust+GTK)
stack.hallucinationFilter: Two-tier Whisper noise filter (phrases + structural patterns)
stack.wefaxDecoder: Self-contained numpy FSK decoder (1500/2300 Hz, LPM deskew, WAV to PNG)
stack.meteorDetector: Forward scatter power monitor (numpy threshold detector)
stack.signalClassifier: MobileNetV2 over IQ spectrograms; trained off-node on x86, exported to ONNX, run on the Pi via onnxruntime (~58 ms). Hailo .hef pending the x86-only Dataflow Compiler
stack.emitterIdentification: 1D CNN + attention SEI model (Hailo-8L NPU, CPU fallback)
stack.iqCapture: pyrtlsdr direct IQ capture with FM/AM/WFM demodulation, squelch, de-emphasis, replaces rtl_fm main pipeline
stack.processArchitecture: Two-process split: ravensdr-ui (Flask+Socket.IO, no hardware) and ravensdr-radio (RTL-SDR/Hailo/decoders, eventlet-free), NDJSON over Unix domain socket
stack.ipc: Newline-delimited JSON over Unix domain socket (ipc.py / ipc_server.py / radio_link.py)
stack.sdrArbitration: SdrArbiter — serialized coalescing command queue, C2 states LOCKED/SWITCHING/FAULT
stack.modelValidation: Held-out-frequency split — whole bands withheld from training; 3 of 6 classes generalise, the rest are marked unproven in the UI
stack.corpusCollection: Background band rotation labelled from the tuned preset, class-balanced, with a spectral peak-to-median gate on empty windows
stack.consoleLayout: Six tabbed views (Listen / Classify / Decoders / Imagery / Science / Model) with view memory and follow-the-radio switching
stack.uiVerification: Headless Chromium over CDP at five viewport sizes (code/scripts/ui_snapshot.py)
stack.digitalDecoders: ADS-B, ACARS, APRS, AIS, ISM/rtl_433, POCSAG/FLEX pager, NOAA APT, WEFAX, meteor scatter
stack.offlineOperation: Fully air-gapped — socket.io, Leaflet and D3 vendored, no CDN or cloud calls

targetHardware.sdr: RTL-SDR Blog V4 (R828D tuner, RTL2832U, 1PPM TCXO)

targetOS: Raspberry Pi OS / Debian Trixie (64-bit, 16 KB pages)
notes: v1.0.0: All 17 phases complete. Full IQ pipeline integrated — pyrtlsdr direct capture feeds signal classifier, SEI emitter fingerprinter, and live spectrogram waterfall. Persistent config system for secondary dongle assignment. WEFAX recording robustness improvements. Classifier and SEI panels wired into main UI.
